user_query: Identify the protein and elucidate its enzyme catalytic activity, especially the chemical reaction catalyzed. Analyze sequence and provide evidence from homologs/annotations; distinguish direct annotation from inference.

warnings: Sequence-derived estimates assume an unmodified protein and do not account for processing, PTMs, bound ligands, or oligomers.
